notes.title: Space Slurpies LAUNCHES April 8th!
notes.content:
You've played the demo, you've heard the song... and now it's FINALLY HERE. Space Slurpies is launching and about to be available for all on April 8th.
[previewyoutube=B6KloBYfous;full][/previewyoutube]

For the past year, Starcade Arcade has been working on a VR game that we are very excited to share with you. It's relaxing to play in solo mode, but equally exciting to play with friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/a4d8445aa52230bd521b745f74952ec73a677dd4.gif[/img]

How long can you survive the colorful galaxy of the Slurpies? In this multiplayer arcade game, control luminescent snakes that grow in length and size. Collect as much food as possible and survive each round without colliding with yourself and other players in fast-pacing battles. The art of collecting food is as satisfying as it is relaxing. But don't forget to watch out for other players – as they might try to cut you off and create traps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/e3dde6e0f0d5ab4124ad3ece5f740a741875eed4.gif[/img]
[list][*] Players each control a snake that follows their hand in 6D space
[*] Whenever their snake eats pieces of food, it grows in length
[*] It also evolves and covers itself in armor as it grows
[*] Survive the longest without colliding with yourself or other players
[*] Competitive players can cut each other off and sabotage to win the game
[*] Avoid the Jazzeroids and other enemy obstacles on your quest to be the longest slurp!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/838d7fc8e4b7c068e620ee94625fdae796b67a66.gif[/img]
[list][*] Enjoy over 20 unique and vibrant maps
[*] Cross platform multiplayer, both matchmaking and games with friends
[*] Customize your snake and make uniquely yours
[/list]

notes.title: Masks and Hard Mode
notes.content:
We introduce the brand new Hard Mode, for those wanting a challenge! Just use the soap dispenser labeled Hard and see what kind of tricks we have ready for you. Faster virus and the inclusion of crazy virus clusters! Hard Mode leaderboards are live as well, so good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37151365/200d9d90d70e4e682a89b6e84f3a50061e6af990.png[/img]

"Beware the publicly-touched objects!" This is what my mom warned my dad the other day when he tried to grab a pen from the pizza delivery guy. This interaction is what inspired the cluster objects that you see in Hard Mode. We'd been getting feedback that people wanted more educational elements brought to Virus Popper, and we thought the warning about touching public objects should be spread to the world. Touching keyboards, retail kiosks, and touchscreens in public increases your chances of getting sick. So avoid touching them and stay safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37151365/809b3987443aa9d8cfc25ab02b5a4831f50629d7.png[/img]

Next, one commonly requested feature is that of the masks. With a lot of countries requesting people wear masks right now, we felt it was appropriate to teach about the importance of wearing masks. Specifically, you will hear that HiGene points out to users that it's not just about wearing the mask to keep yourself safe… it is just as important that people wear masks in order to keep other people from getting sick. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37151365/4997439f99db0b3045519064787419c9e96a4241.png[/img]

New Features:
	- A mask is available for user's to put on and protect themselves from incoming virus.
	- HiGene explains to the user that masks are just as much about protecting other people as yourself.
	- Droplet has additional educational lines to teach the user about washing with soap.
	- Leaderboards can be viewed in-game, with five fully enabled leaderboards available to the user.
	- High scores are saved and shown to the player onscreen.
	- 11 Achievements are available for user's to achieve denoting different goals.
	- An additional gameplay mode, Hard Mode, is added for players to have an additional challenge.
	- Hard Mode features virus clusters to teach about the danger of using public devices likes touch screens, phones, door handles, and keyboards.
	- Droplet has multiple new intros in order to add some variation.
	- After a user puts soap on their hand, they don't have to repeat… in order to make for a less confusing experience.
	- Music controls allow the user to mute or skip songs if they'd like from the jukebox.
	- HiGene responds to the user and teaches about social distancing whenever the user touches him.

Bug fixes:
	- Scores disappear and don't overlay title after a game is complete.
	- Any viruses floating in the air will automatically die after a period of time.
	- Multiple objects cannot be picked up at the same time.
	- User can grab the same object that they ended the last game with.
	- The table is lowered further to make sure that it is out of the way of the user.
Spray bottle image was flipped. Now adjusted to always face the right direction.

notes.title: Leaderboards Activated!
notes.content:
Hello Virus Poppers! 

This exciting patch opens up Steam leaderboards. We are beyond excited to see just how long people are able to survive against those poppers. Hope you can impress us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37151365/56b2598342c37dc53ecfa5795da9cd23179a0fe3.png[/img]

Leaderboards features three boards total:
[list]
[*] The highest score achieved by a person in a single game.
[*] The longest time that someone was able to survive in a game.
[*] The most number of toilet paper rolls that someone collects in a game.
[/list]

For each leaderboard, you can filter by three different methods:
[list]
[*] User - in the first filter, you get to see how you rank compared to all of the other players around you. Every journey begins with a single step, so why don't you try to take that slot above you!
[*] Global - You can view the top scores and see the names of the champions that grace the Virus Popper arenea.
[*] Friends - Compare against your friends and egg them on to see who can get the higher score. At least, that's what we're doing even as developers!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=5LjQzykC22g;full][/previewyoutube]

Bug Fixes and Tweaks:
[list]
[*] Toilet paper used to disappear if a disinfectant bottle power-up showed up and came in contact with the player's hand. Now, it will effectively remain blocked with toilet paper so that you can rack up those rolls.
[/list]
